top_stories.title: Illinois Lawmakers Just Passed America's Strongest AI Safety Bill [Metered]
top_stories.summary: Illinois has passed what is being described as the most significant AI safety legislation in the United States to date, with Governor Pritzker's support. The bill sets new standards for AI governance and safety requirements. This marks a notable step in state-level AI regulation as federal action remains limited.

top_stories.title: Cisco and OpenAI redefine enterprise engineering with Codex
top_stories.summary: OpenAI and Cisco have announced a partnership to deploy Codex within Cisco's enterprise engineering workflows. The collaboration aims to accelerate software development and automation at scale across Cisco's operations. The announcement highlights growing enterprise adoption of OpenAI's coding tools.

top_stories.title: OpenAI: Building self-improving tax agents with Codex
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has published details on how Codex is being used to build self-improving tax agents capable of iterating on their own performance over time. The use case demonstrates agentic AI applied to complex, domain-specific professional tasks. It represents a concrete example of AI agents being deployed in high-stakes financial contexts.

top_stories.title: Warp's big bet on building open source with GPT-5.5
top_stories.summary: OpenAI has published a case study on Warp, the AI-powered terminal, and its decision to build core open source tooling using GPT-5.5. The piece outlines how Warp is integrating large language models deeply into developer workflows. It offers an early look at real-world applications of OpenAI's latest model generation.

top_stories.title: Robinhood will let your AI agent trade stocks and make (or lose) lots of money
top_stories.summary: Robinhood is introducing support for AI agents to autonomously execute stock trades on behalf of users. The feature raises significant questions around financial risk, accountability, and the role of automated decision-making in retail investing. It marks a notable expansion of agentic AI into consumer financial services.

further_links.title: YouTube is putting AI labels where you'll actually see them
further_links.summary: YouTube is updating its approach to AI-generated content labels, making them more prominent and automatically applied to qualifying videos and Shorts.

further_links.title: OpenAI: Election information and safeguards in 2026
further_links.summary: OpenAI has outlined the safety measures and information policies it is implementing around elections in 2026, covering how its tools handle election-related queries.

further_links.title: Why the Vatican Invited Anthropic to the Pope's AI Encyclical Presentation [Metered]
further_links.summary: Anthropic researcher Christopher Olah was among the AI figures invited to the Vatican for the presentation of Pope Leo XIV's encyclical on AI, reflecting the Church's engagement with leading AI safety researchers.

further_links.title: Millions of AI agents imperiled by critical vulnerability in open source package
further_links.summary: A critical security vulnerability in a widely used open source package has been found to put millions of AI agent deployments at risk, according to Ars Technica.

further_links.title: YouTube will let you ask AI to make a custom video feed
further_links.summary: YouTube is rolling out a feature allowing users to prompt an AI to generate a personalised video feed based on their described interests.

further_links.title: Former Google and Apple Researchers Launch a Startup to Build AI's Missing Feedback Loop [Metered]
further_links.summary: Ex-Google and Apple AI researchers have founded a startup focused on building systems that allow AI models to improve continuously based on real-world user interactions.

further_links.title: The AI fight brewing inside The New York Times
further_links.summary: The New York Times Tech Guild is pushing for contractual protections around AI monitoring and performance evaluation of journalists, signalling growing internal tensions over AI use in newsrooms.

further_links.title: DuckDuckGo search saw 28% more visits after Google said people love AI mode
further_links.summary: DuckDuckGo recorded a nearly 28% increase in visits in the week following Google's public promotion of its AI-powered search mode, suggesting some user resistance to AI-integrated search.

further_links.title: Bay Area mom out thousands after scammers use AI to mimic daughter's voice
further_links.summary: A Bay Area mother lost thousands of dollars to scammers who used AI voice cloning to impersonate her daughter in a fake kidnapping scheme, highlighting the growing threat of AI-enabled fraud.

further_links.title: SilverTorch: Index as Model — A New Retrieval Paradigm for Recommendation Systems
further_links.summary: Meta's engineering blog details SilverTorch, a new retrieval approach that treats the index itself as a model, aiming to improve the efficiency and accuracy of large-scale recommendation systems.

ethan_mollick.title: Choosing to Stay Human
ethan_mollick.summary: Ethan Mollick explores the tensions around human identity and agency as AI becomes increasingly capable, asking what it means to deliberately choose to remain human in tasks and interactions. He examines the trade-offs between AI-assisted efficiency and the personal and social value of doing things ourselves. The piece encourages a thoughtful, intentional approach to deciding where AI should and should not replace human effort.
